Container.Name: OnScreen
Container.Overview: OnScreen is a free, open-source (AGPL-3.0) media server for movies, TV, anime, music, audiobooks, podcasts, books and photos, built on PostgreSQL. Hardware transcoding, Dolby Vision, bit-perfect music, Live TV and DVR, and apps for the web, Windows and Linux, Android phone (with Android Auto), Android TV / Google TV, Fire TV, LG, Samsung, Roku, Xbox and Meta Quest. No paid tier.[br][br]Needs two other containers first: PostgreSQL 16+ (the stock postgres:16 image) and Valkey or Redis 7+. Point DATABASE_URL and VALKEY_URL at them. Set a SECRET_KEY (32+ random bytes) and keep it: it encrypts stored tokens and keys.
Container.Requires: A PostgreSQL 16+ container (postgres:16) with a database and user for OnScreen, and a Valkey or Redis 7+ container.

Config.Name: Web UI port
Config.Description: The web app and the API. Every OnScreen app connects here.

Config.Name: Media
Config.Description: Your media share, read-only. Add libraries under /media in Settings after first sign-in.

Config.Name: Cache
Config.Description: Image resize cache and other regenerable state.

Config.Name: Backups
Config.Description: Where the scheduled database backup task writes its dumps. They contain the whole database: keep this share private.

Config.Name: DATABASE_URL
Config.Description: PostgreSQL connection string. Replace CHANGE_ME with the database password and YOUR_UNRAID_IP with the server's address (or the Postgres container's name on a custom network).

Config.Name: SECRET_KEY
Config.Description: 32+ random bytes, e.g. the output of: openssl rand -hex 32. Keep it; changing it invalidates every sign-in and stored key.

Config.Name: AUTO_MIGRATE
Config.Description: Apply database migrations at startup. Leave on for a single-container setup.

Config.Name: TMDB_API_KEY
Config.Description: Optional TMDB v3 key for movie and TV metadata; can also be set later in Settings.

Config.Name: TRUSTED_PROXIES
Config.Description: Optional: your reverse proxy's IP or CIDR, so OnScreen trusts its X-Forwarded-* headers.

Config.Name: RTMP ingest port
Config.Description: Optional: OBS / ffmpeg go-live broadcasts into Live TV.

Config.Name: LAN discovery port
Config.Description: Optional: lets apps on your network find the server without typing its address.
